cards.power: Play when a scene is calm. Force an immediate aggression check.
cards.lore: Peace is a failure of imagination. If it's quiet, you're doing it wrong.

cards.power: Interrupt any action. A new threat enters the scene immediately.
cards.lore: When in doubt, have a man come through the door with a gun.

cards.power: Target player becomes irrationally angry at an ally. Logic is negated.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: comic chaos. Subject: raccoons fighting over glowing orb, one turning on ally. Mood: irrational fury.

cards.gradeReason: Just a '?' glyph — concept is there but card fails to invite anything. Missed opportunity even as a gag.

cards.power: Target player makes the worst tactical choice available.

cards.power: Maximum social damage. Turn an ally into a nemesis instantly.

verdict: DRAMATIC DROPS & KRAZY KONFLIKTS is the expansion slot machine jackpot — 56 cards of pure narrative sabotage organized into 8 thematic chaos categories plus 6 expansion packs. The Meta-Game section is the MVP (HAND WAVE, RETCON RAY, CLIFFHANGER are textbook G1), and TEMPTING FATE might be the platonic ideal of a Kayfabizarro card: the verbal trigger IS the mechanic. Only POOR COMMS whiffs hard — an empty '?' card is a missed punchline, not a finished one. Table-ready: YES.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: DRAMATIC DROPS & KRAZY KONFLIKTS – Peace Is a Design Failure (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

A plot at rest is a plot quietly dying. Here is the crowbar.

You were sold the tidy version of storytelling: three clean acts, a likeable arc, harmony restored by the final page. The screenwriting gurus call that craft. It is really just a story standing so still it forgot to be interesting. A draft that never bleeds never earns its ending, and a hero who never loses anything was never in a story to begin with, only a brochure for one.

A Social Story Wrestling deck for storytellers who think peace is a design failure: 56 cut-and-play cards built to wreck your plot on purpose and rebuild it louder. You drop a card, you commit to the damage out loud, and the table decides whether your narrative survives the hit or collapses into something far better. Wrestling for everyone whose first draft was too polite to live.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Dramatic Drops Core Deck: 56 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" cards, featuring THE MONOLOGUE, where your villain talks long enough to lose, THE CONFLICT BALL, the contrivance that hands the nicest character a reason to swing, and the DISPOSABLE SIDEKICK, who exists for exactly one heartbreaking scene.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and a deck that punishes any scene cowardly enough to resolve itself early.
- The Escalation Engine: six themed acts you run in sequence, THE SUFFERING, THE SECRETS, THE CLICHES, THE TIMING, THE ESCALATION, and THE VILLAINS, so a calm campfire chat detonates into TEMPTING FATE and a full WORLD OF HAM by the time the dust clears.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
This deck is part of the Kayfabizarro main line. Grab it and you are not buying a frozen PDF, you are on the Protopian Pipeline: every future expansion, trope, and act in this cycle reaches you as a free update, no second checkout.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I draw comics, and I have never once trusted a plot that did not fight back. This is the box of trouble I keep reaching for when a story turns obedient and dull. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Print it, cut it, ruin a draft on purpose. Want to support the craft? Every euro goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next cards and sharpening the chaos.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"A story only earns its ending by surviving everything you were too polite to throw at it."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
